verdict.rationale: A native mobile app is a fair question for a work-management SaaS like monday.com, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions a monday.com mobile app or feature parity with desktop. Reaching agents from WhatsApp or Telegram, and the integrations' 'cross-platform view', are different capabilities and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can manage my tasks from a full-featured native mobile app without missing desktop functionality
